svg.title: Master-slave flip-flop built from two NAND d_latch blocks
svg.desc: Schematic of the master and slave latches with live open/holding status, above a real simulation timing diagram of CLK, D, Q_M and Q with a sweeping cursor. Q only changes on rising clock edges.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two d_latch blocks in series. They are open on opposite clock levels, so the output can only change on a rising edge.

svg.text: Power-up: Q is unknown (U) until the first rising edge.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rising edge: the slave opens and Q takes the master's value, 0.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CLK = 0: the master is open and follows D. The slave is holding.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: D rises while CLK = 0. The master follows (Q_M = 1), but Q does not move.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rising edge: the slave copies Q_M, so Q becomes 1.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: D falls while CLK = 1. The master is locked, so nothing changes.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Falling edge: the master reopens and takes D = 0. Q still holds 1.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rising edge: the slave copies Q_M and Q finally becomes 0.
